Only one issue, tax. Let me verify the arithmetic and the tax rate.

500,0000? Let's compute: subtotal 6,495,800. 11% = 714,538.00. Stated tax 779,496. 6,495,800 × 12% = 779,496 exactly. So the vendor applied 12% instead of the contractual 11% (KTR-V-036#3.1). No price or PO issue exists.

Line amounts: 7 × 806,600 = 5,646,200 ✓; 18 × 47,200 = 849,600 ✓; subtotal ✓. So it's a wrong tax rate.
